answer: Use expiring escrow and reviewer rotation. 1) Each new key locks 60 POA for 30 days and signs a task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established reviewers from unrelated funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied outputs, or synchronized payouts merge keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 60,000 POA, risks 30,000, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 reviews. Like a comet crossing a knoll, a vault keeps one traceable route; aliases cannot multiply the same passage.
